questions.question: Δ ABC is similar to Δ PQR. The area of Δ ABC is 64 cm², and the area of Δ PQR is 121 cm². If QR = 15.4 cm, what is the length of BC?
questions.solution:
Given:

ΔABC is similar to ΔPQR

Area of ΔABC is 64 cm2

Area of ΔPQR is 121 cm2

QR = 15.4 cm 

Concept: 

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the ratio of the squares of the corresponding sides & medians. 

**Calculations:**

According to concept:

area(ΔABC)/area(ΔPQR) = BC2/QR2

⇒ 64/121 = BC2/QR2 

⇒ √(64/121) = BC/QR

⇒ 8/11 = BC/15.4

⇒BC = (15.4 × 8)/11

⇒BC = 11.2

∴ BC = 11.2 cm

questions.question: The ratio of time taken by Anamika and Bani to complete a work is 1 ∶ 3, respectively. Therefore, Anamika is able to finish a job in 40 days less than Bani. If they work together, they can complete the work in ______ days.

Efficiency = Total work/Time taken

Calculation:

Let time taken by Anamika and Bani be x and 3x respectively.

x + 40 = 3x

⇒ x = 20

Hence, Anamika takes 20 days and Bani takes 60 days.

questions.question: In a right circular cylinder, the ratio of the curved surface to the total surface area is 3 ∶ 7. Find the ratio of the height of the cylinder to the radius of its base.
questions.solution:
Given:

Ratio of the curved surface area and total surface area of a cylinder is 3 ∶ 7.

**Formula used:**

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh

Total surface area of cylinder = 2πrh + 2πr2

Calculation:

According to question,

Curved surface area/ Total surface area= 3/7

⇒ 2πrh/(2πrh + 2πr2) = (3)/(7)

⇒ 2πrh/[2πr(h + r)] = (3)/(7)

⇒ h/(h + r) = (3)/(7)

⇒ 7h = 3h + 3r

⇒ 7h - 4h = 3r

⇒ 4h = 3r

⇒ h/r = 3/4

⇒ h : r = 3 : 4

∴ The ratio of Height and Radius of a Cylinder is 3 : 4.

questions.question: A fruit seller purchased 300 bananas at the rate of ₹18 per dozen and sold 200 bananas at the rate of ₹24 per dozen and the remaining bananas at the rate of ₹21 per dozen. What is his net profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The Cost Price (CP) of 300 bananas at = ₹18 per dozen 

The Selling Price (SP₁) of 200 bananas at = ₹24 per dozen 

The Selling Price (SP₂) of remaining bananas at = ₹21 per dozen.

**Concept used:**

Profit% = SP - CPover CP × 100

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

12 banana = 1 dozen

⇒ 300 banana = 300/12 = 25 dozens

Cost Price of 25 dozens = 25 × 18 = Rs. 450

He Sold 200 bananas at Rs. 24 per dozen

⇒ 200 bananas = 200/12 = 16.66 dozens

Cost price of 16.66 dozens of bananas = 16.66 × 24

⇒ Rs. 399.84 ~ Rs. 400

He Sold 100 bananas at Rs. 21 per dozen

⇒ 100 bananas = 100/12 = 8.33 dozens

Cost price of 8.33 dozens of bananas = 8.33 × 21

⇒ Rs. 174.93 ~ Rs. 175

Net Selling Price = 400 + 175 = Rs. 575

Net Profit% = [(575 - 450)/(450)] × 100

⇒ Net Profit% = [125/450] × 100

⇒ Net Profit% = 0.2777 × 100 = 27.77% or ​​​​27(7)/(9)\%​​​

**∴ ​​​His net profit percentage = 27.77% or ​​​​27(7)/(9)\%​ .**

questions.question: Under a sale offer, Tanvir was offered a 32% discount on the part of the marked price that was paid in cash, but had to add 1.2% on the part of the marked price paid through a credit card. If Tanvir paid 75% of the marked price in cash and the rest through a credit card, what percentage of the marked price was his total final payment?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount% on part of MP is 32% 

Credit Card Discount on part of MP is 1.2%

Tanvir paid 75% of the marked price in cash and the rest through a credit card

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Payment in cash,

Payment = [(100 - 32)/100] × 75/100 × MP

⇒ 68/100 × 75/100 × MP

⇒ (68 × 75)/10000 × MP

⇒ 5100/10000 × MP

⇒ Payement = 0.51MP

Payment in card,

Payment = [(100 + 1.2)/100] × [(100 - 75)/100] × MP

⇒ 101.2/100 × 25/100 × MP

⇒ (101.2 × 25)/10000 × MP

⇒ 2530/10000 × MP

⇒ Payement = 0.235MP

Total Payment = 0.51MP + 0.253 MP = 0.763 MP

Now, Percentage = 0.763MP/ MP × 100 = 76.3%

**∴ His total final payment was 76.3%.**

questions.question: If x⁴ + 1over x⁴ = 14159, Then a Possible value of x + 1over x is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 x⁴ + 1over x⁴ = 14159

**Formula used:**

 x⁴ + 1over x⁴ = {(x + (1)/(x)**)²** - 2}² - 2

**Calculations:**

 x⁴ + 1over x⁴ = 14159

Rightarrow (x² +(1)/(x²))² = 14161

Rightarrow x² + (1)/(x²) = √14161 = 119

Rightarrow (x + (1)/(x))² = 121

Rightarrow x + (1)/(x) = √121 = 11

**∴ x + (1)/(x) = 11**
